Gen-HumanWholeBody Dataset Card
	



	
		
	
	
		Dataset Summary
	

Gen-HumanWholeBody is a high-precision whole-body manipulation dataset captured from DAS-Ego, released by GenRobot.AI. It contains 600 hours of continuous whole-body human manipulation data reconstructed via GenRobot's proprietary Data Foundation Model (DFM), with an average joint position error of approximately 3 cm.
